features.name: Document package store (persistence + assets)
features.description:
Implement `DocumentPersistence` and `AssetStore` (NibContracts) for `.nibnote` packages (`NibFormat.packageExtension`) inside the library folder, and install them in `register` (`app.workspace.persistence = …`, `app.services.assets = …`). Layout (ARCHITECTURE §4): `doc..json` = `DocumentContent` JSON; `pages//.nibpage` = LZFSE-compressed JSON `[Item]` encoded with `userInfo[.nibCompactPoints] = true`; `assets/.`; `audio/…`. `` = `DeviceIdentity.hex`. loadHead/loadItems read EVERY device file (including provider conflict copies, defined exactly as file names matching `^doc\.[0-9a-f]{8}.+\.json$` or `pages/

/[0-9a-f]{8}.+\.nibpage` — i.e. anything after the 8 hex device chars other than the exact `doc.<8hex>.json` / `<8hex>.nibpage`) and merge with `LWW.merge` (meta: highest rev); conflict copies are deleted after their content is merged into this device's file. didChange: debounce 1.5 s, write on one serial background queue with NSFileCoordinator and atomic writes; this device writes only its own files, containing the full merged state; flush() writes synchronously. remoteChanges(doc): re-read other devices' files whose mtime changed and return records newer than the in-memory copy. Write-ahead log: append each didChange payload as JSONL to Application Support/Nib/wal/.jsonl, truncate after a successful write, replay on load. Tombstones older than 30 days are dropped on write (`ponytail:` note). Format gate: a head with `meta.format > NibFormat.version` loads read-only (writes throw `NibError(.unsupported)`, flag exposed via `services.set(…, for: "store.readOnly")`). `DocumentPersistence` is `@MainActor`: snapshot on main, write on the serial queue. Package URLs come from `app.services.packages` (the thread-safe `PackageLocator`, captured in `register`; F002 fills it) — never from `LibraryService` or any other main-actor type off-main; `AssetStore` captures the same locator. Revs more than 24 h in the future are distrusted by `LWW.merge` (`Rev.effective`) and reported as a `sync.status` warning. AssetStore: sha256 (CryptoKit) dedupe, temp assets in Caches/Nib/tmp expiring after 1 h. Acceptance: save→load round trip equals; two DeviceIdentity values writing one package converge; conflict copy merged then removed; WAL replay after simulated crash; compact points identical; format gate; asset dedupe; 1k-stroke page decode+merge asserted with `XCTAssertLessThan(elapsed, 0.05 * 4)` (not an unbaselined `measure {}`); the conflict-copy regex is unit-tested against positive and negative file names. Module NibStore, entry type NibStoreFeature (id "store"); import only NibContracts, Apple frameworks and the allowed packages; follow ARCHITECTURE.md §15.

features.name: Library store (folders, documents, trash, prefs)
features.description: Implement `LibraryService` (NibContracts) and set `app.services.library` + `app.settings.syncedBackend`. Root = security-scoped bookmark stored in UserDefaults (default: app Documents; `setRoot` re-bookmarks and rescans). Folders are directories carrying per-device `.nibfolder.<dev>.json` {id, rev, color, icon, favorite} files merged by rev (each device writes only its own, ARCHITECTURE §4.3); documents are `*.nibnote` packages (folders named `*.nib` that contain `doc.*.json` are legacy packages: listed and renamed to `.nibnote` with NSFileCoordinator on first open) whose id is read from their merged head; catalog cached as JSON in Application Support and refreshed incrementally (listing 5,000 documents < 300 ms); `LibraryNode.sync` from URL resource values (ubiquitous downloading/uploading/error). Trash = move into `<root>/.nib-library/trash/` recording `meta.trashedFrom`; restore returns to that path or root. Duplicate copies the package and rewrites a new document id into this device's head (other devices' heads removed). Library prefs (`SyncedSettingsBackend`, incl. `names()`) = `.nib-library/prefs.<dev>.json` files merged per key by rev (collections are one key per entry, so concurrent additions never collide). Keeps `app.services.packages` (PackageLocator) in sync with the catalog (`replaceAll` after each refresh). Exposes `library.inContainer` (root inside the app container) for F070/F093. `doc.create` builds the first content: notebook = optional cover page (NibSettings.defaultCover) + paper page (NibSettings.defaultPaper, defaultPageSize); whiteboard = one board with size nil; text doc = one heading block; study set = empty. Emits `library.changed`. Refreshes the catalog node when committed meta (favorite, locked, kind) changes. Acceptance: all commands with Fixtures examples; trash → recover restores the original folder; duplicate gets a new id; prefs merge across two device files; `.nibfolder.<dev>.json` style edits from two devices merge by rev; unit tests on a temp directory. Commands owned: doc.create {kind, title?, folder?, template?, size?, cover?, pages?, id?} (library); doc.setFavorite {doc, favorite} (edit); doc.merge {source, into} (library); folder.create {title, parent?, color?, icon?, id?} (library); folder.setStyle {folder, color?, icon?, favorite?} (library); library.list {folder?, sort?, kinds?} (read); library.rename {ref, title} (library); library.move {refs, folder?} (library); library.duplicate {refs, ids?} (library); library.trash {refs} (library); trash.list {} (read); trash.recover {refs, folder?} (library); trash.deletePermanently {refs} (irreversible); trash.empty {} (irreversible). Module NibLibrary, entry type NibLibraryFeature (id "library"); import only NibContracts, Apple frameworks and the allowed packages; follow ARCHITECTURE.md §15.

features.name: Query, node & asset API
features.description: The universal read API and raw-edit escape hatch used by AI, plugins and the bridge (ARCHITECTURE §7). Query results follow the shapes in ARCHITECTURE §7.2 (refs as `NodeRef` strings, bboxes as [x,y,w,h]); results are capped at 20 KB (NibLimits.aiToolResultBytes) with `cursor` + `truncated`. Locked documents (services.lock) are reported as {"locked": true} and never expanded for non-user principals; `query.tree` omits their contents. node.set = encode record → `JSONValue.merging` → decode → `DocTransaction.put` (so every raw edit is type-checked). node.move of an item across pages keeps its id (tombstone + insert on the target page). item.create fills `layer` from `ctx.activeSession?.activeLayer`. Acceptance: every command has Fixtures examples and passes the conformance undo round trip; query.get of FIXTUREPG001 lists the 10 fixture items (one per kind); a 500-stroke page truncates with a cursor that pages correctly. Protected fields: for non-user principals, `node.set`/`item.update`/`node.insert` reject `createdBy`, `rev`, `deleted`, `id` (on update), `meta.format`, `meta.locked` and `meta.trashedFrom` with `invalid_params` and the JSON path (`DocTransaction.put` also stamps provenance itself). Stroke edits: an item.update/node.set patch of `stroke` either replaces the whole point array (`{"fmt": "xy"|…, "pts": [...]}` — `fmt` is required with `pts`) or a subset of `style`; after the merge the stroke goes through `InkModel.prepare` (densify + nib sizes) so bounds and dirty rects are right. `asset.put {url}` and every url param resolve through `ctx.inputFile` (tmp: refs, https, file:// only for the user). `asset.upload` stores bytes as a temporary asset and returns its `tmp:` ref for any url-taking command. Acceptance additions: patching FIXTURESTK01 with fmt "xy" points stores widths > 0, updates the bbox and passes the undo round trip; an AI `item.create` with `createdBy: "user"` is stored as `ai:<chat>`; an AI `node.set` of `meta.locked` fails with invalid_params at `$.fields.meta.locked`. Commands owned: query.context {session?} (read); query.tree {root?, depth?} (read); query.get {ref, depth?, fields?, points?} (read); query.find {in, kinds?, layer?, bbox?, where?, text?, limit?, cursor?} (read); node.insert {parent, node, at?, id?} (edit); node.set {ref, fields} (edit); node.remove {ref} (edit); node.move {ref, to, at?} (edit); item.create {page, item, id?} (edit); item.update {ref, patch} (edit); asset.put {doc, base64? | url?, ext} (edit); asset.get {doc, asset} (read); asset.upload {base64, ext} (session). Module FeatQuery, entry type FeatQueryFeature (id "query"); import only NibContracts, Apple frameworks and the allowed packages; follow ARCHITECTURE.md §15.

features.name: Page renderer (tiles, ink compositing, thumbnails)
features.description: Implement `PageRenderer` (NibContracts) and set `app.services.renderer`; register the default drawer for `custom` items using `DisplayList.draw(in:origin:assets:doc:)` from NibContracts (templates use the same call) and use `app.content.drawer(for:)` for every other non-stroke kind. Snapshot model data on the main actor, render off-main (OperationQueue, max 3). Compositing order per tile: background (template DisplayList from `app.content.template`, PDF via one CGPDFDocument per worker, image, or colour) → items in z order grouped into bands: consecutive PencilKit-renderable strokes (pen/pencil solid) drawn with `PKBridge.drawing(...).image(from:scale:)` inside a light trait collection; highlighter strokes as a multiply band (normal at 55% alpha on dark paper); dashed/dotted strokes filled from `InkOutline` (NibContracts) with the dash pattern; everything else via drawers. Respects `RenderRequest.layers/hidden/background/annotations/replay` (spotlight = alpha 0.25 for strokes with t0 > time, reveal = partial point counts, showAll = normal) and draws Set-of-Mark boxes when `marks` (returns mark→ref). Tiles 512 px, scale buckets = next power of two; thumbnails/previews cached in Caches/Nib/previews keyed by doc/page/max rev (never Swift `Hasher`). Invalidates via `app.bus.observeCommits` + `Changeset.dirtyRect`; `purgeCaches` on memory warnings. Acceptance: render of the fixture page returns an image of the requested size; a highlighter over text multiplies; dashed stroke visible; performance: 150-stroke tile asserted with `XCTAssertLessThan(elapsed, 0.008 * 4)`; `render.page` of FIXTUREPG001 with marks=true returns one mark per live fixture item (10) mapping to their refs; the long edge of a render never exceeds 1568 px. Drawers get everything through `DrawContext` (captured `AssetStore`); nothing off-main touches NibApp/NibServices. Commands owned: render.page {page, scale?, region?, marks?, layers?, background?} (read) → {asset: "tmp:<name>" (temporary PNG via `services.assets.putTemporary`), pxPerPt, region, marks?: {"1": "item:…"}}; scale is reduced so the long edge ≤ 1568 px; example `{"page": "page:FIXTUREDOC01/FIXTUREPG001", "marks": true}`. Module NibRender, entry type NibRenderFeature (id "render"); import only NibContracts, Apple frameworks and the allowed packages; follow ARCHITECTURE.md §15.

features.name: Canvas: scroll, zoom, page layout, tiles & whiteboard world
features.description: The notebook/whiteboard editor (`DocumentEditorDescriptor` for .notebook and .whiteboard) implementing `DocumentEditing` and `CanvasHost` (`canvasView`, `overlayLayer` for the active tool). DocumentScrollView: vertical continuous or horizontal paged (meta.scrollDirection), single-page layout, page frames by prefix sums + binary search, ~5 recycled PageTileViews showing tiles from `services.renderer` (baked on zoom end), right-edge scrubber in horizontal mode, page-number indicator clear of the toolbar, overscroll past the last page offers `page.add`. Zoom: pinch, double-tap, keyboard via view.zoom; 50–800% notebooks, 5–400% boards. Pages with `size == nil` are an infinite world canvas. Hosts `ui.canvasAttachments`: one instance per canvas host, each with its own layer, `canvasDidChange` on scroll/zoom/layout/commit, detached on close. Built-in decoration attachment for `canvas.decorate` (transient DisplayLists per page with ttl, drawn with `DisplayList.draw`; plugins reach it through `nib.canvas.decorate`). Live views via attachLiveView; read-only disables ink. Input (wet ink, touches, palm rejection, gesture routing) is F101 in the same module: F006 declares an internal `CanvasInputHooks` (e.g. `static var install: ((CanvasHostImpl) -> Void)?`) that F101 fills in its register — F006 never references F101 types, so it compiles alone. Acceptance: page-layout unit tests (both directions, mixed sizes, 300 pages); attachment lifecycle with a fake attachment (attach → canvasDidChange on zoom → detach); decoration expiry; view.* examples; a 300-page layout computes in < 50 ms (asserted). Device-only checks (drawing latency, 60 fps scrolling, rotation) are bridge smoke scripts in tools/smoke (F111), not PR checklists. Commands owned: view.goToPage {page | index} (session); view.zoom {scale? | fit? | actual?} (session); view.scrollBy {dx, dy} (session); view.reveal {ref} (session); canvas.decorate {page, id, display, ttl?} (session); canvas.clearDecorations {id?} (session). Module FeatCanvas, entry type FeatCanvasFeature (id "canvas"); import only NibContracts, NibDesign, Apple frameworks and the allowed packages; follow ARCHITECTURE.md §15.

features.name: Canvas input: wet ink, touch pipeline, palm rejection & gesture routing
features.description: Second half of the canvas, in the same module as F006 (uses its internal types; installs itself through F006's internal `CanvasInputHooks`). Wet ink: one transparent PKCanvasView (drawingPolicy from NibSettings.stylusMode) on the active page (+ a multiply-blended one for the highlighter), strokes converted with `PKBridge.stroke(from:)`, run through `app.content.strokeProcessors`, then `ink.addStrokes`; a wet stroke is removed only after its dry tiles land. TouchTap: coalesced/predicted touches (NibSettings.reduceLatency), Pencil Pro roll (`UITouch.rollAngle` behind `#available(iOS 17.5, *)`), hold detection → `CanvasTool.strokeHeld`, 0.5 s long-press. Software palm rejection by majorRadius per palmSensitivity/writingPosture as a pure `PalmRejection` type. GestureRouter — the order for every touch: (1) `ui.canvasAttachments` whose `hitTest` claims it (registry order), (2) for finger tap / double-tap / long-press, `app.content.tapHandlers` (lowest order first; params {page, point, ref, gesture} where ref = topmost live item; `itemKinds`/`drawKeys` filters; only `worksInReadOnly` handlers in read-only mode; first {handled:true} wins), (3) the active tool (`ui.canvasTools` + `session.tool`). Pencil double-tap/squeeze/hover → `ui.pencilHandler`. Acceptance: GestureRouter unit tests with a fake CanvasHost (attachment claim wins; first handled handler wins; kind and read-only filters; fall-through to the tool); palm-rejection tests on synthetic touches; the commit path calls `ink.addStrokes` (a stand-in command registered in the test). Module FeatCanvas, entry type FeatCanvasInputFeature (id "canvasinput"); import only NibContracts, NibDesign, Apple frameworks and the allowed packages; follow ARCHITECTURE.md §15.

features.name: Pen & pencil tools, ink command, pen gestures
features.description: Canvas tools "pen" (fountain/ball/brush → PKInk fountainPen/monoline/pen) and "pencil" (PKInk.pencil) in `.pencilKit` mode; style from `NibSettings.presets("pen"|"pencil")` + pen settings (setting keys `pen.style`, `pen.tipSharpness`, `pen.pressure`, `pen.tipFlatness`, `pen.reactToRoll`, `pen.stabilization`). Toolbar items (P, 2) and settings popover (styles, sliders, Reduce Latency → NibSettings.reduceLatency, Draw and Hold toggle `shapes.drawAndHold`, Pen Gestures toggles `gestures.scribbleErase` / `gestures.circleLasso`, Writing Aids toggles (via `doc.setWritingAids`, F104), Disconnect Stylus → NibSettings.stylusMode). Registers StrokeProcessor "pen.stabilize" (EMA, amount = setting). Gestures in strokeFinished: dense back-and-forth scribble → `ink.scribbleErase` and drop the stroke; closed loop + long-press on it within 3 s → `selection.fromLoop`. strokeHeld → `shape.recognize`; if matched, consume and live-adjust scale/rotation in the overlay, then `shape.create` with drawnWith. Dashed/dotted presets switch to `.samples` input with a vector preview. ink.addStrokes: validates, runs `InkModel.prepare` on every stroke (densifies zero-width AI/plugin/synthesised strokes to ≤ 1.5 pt spacing with tripled end points, then derives nib sizes — PencilKit treats points as B-spline control points), assigns layer = active layer, honours caller ids, one transaction for all strokes. ink.setPoints replaces a stroke's points ({fmt, pts}, whole array) and re-prepares it. Acceptance: scribble/loop detectors unit-tested on synthetic points; ink.addStrokes example with fmt "xy" passes undo round trip; a 5-point AI rectangle is stored densified with widths > 0; stabilizer keeps endpoints. Commands owned: ink.addStrokes {page, strokes[], ids?} (edit); ink.setStyle {refs, style} (edit); ink.setPoints {ref, fmt, pts} (edit). Module FeatPen, entry type FeatPenFeature (id "pen"); import only NibContracts, NibDesign, Apple frameworks and the allowed packages; follow ARCHITECTURE.md §15.

features.name: MCP / HTTP bridge server
features.description: NWListener HTTP/1.1 server (docs/AI.md §6): Content-Length bodies ≤ 32 MB, chunked requests rejected, Connection: close; checks before routing: remote IP in allowed CIDRs (loopback, RFC1918, Tailscale 100.64/10 and fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48, link-local), `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (32 random bytes base64url, prefix "nib_", Keychain, constant-time compare), Origin absent or allowlisted. Routes: POST /mcp (Streamable HTTP JSON mode: initialize with protocol negotiation, notifications/initialized, ping, tools/list from NibContracts' `ToolCatalog` (the same catalogue as the in-app agent) + nib_events, tools/call as `.bridge(clientName)` returning text/image content), GET /mcp → 405, DELETE /mcp ends the session, POST /api/v1/call, GET /api/v1/assets/<token> (5-minute URLs), GET /health. Bonjour `_nib._tcp`; foreground only (restart on foreground). MCPHandler is transport-free. Results that carry `tmp:` assets (renders, exports, audio) are rewritten to `/api/v1/assets/<token>` URLs; `sensitive` commands are always confirmed on the device. Also owns tools/smoke/run.mjs (a Node runner that plays tools/smoke/*.json scripts — tool calls plus expectations — against a device through the bridge) and its README, so every wave can be smoke-tested on the sideloaded build. Confirmations appear on the device; requests wait ≤ 120 s. Acceptance: golden JSON-RPC tests (initialize, tools/list, tools/call ok/error, image result); HTTP parser tests; CIDR tests. Commands owned: bridge.setEnabled {enabled} (session); bridge.status {} (read).
